title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Hazardous-Waste Fee on Coverage Re-decisions by System Repaired
content:
**Clause.** For a coverage re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the hazardous-waste fee repaid follows the system repaired. The fee and the labor lines are read from the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.
- **Air-conditioning or cooling repair, all labor on the repaired line.** Where every customer-pay labor charge on the repair order belongs to the repaired concern line, the whole hazardous-waste fee charged is repaid.
- **Air-conditioning or cooling repair, labor on other lines too.** Where the repair order also carries customer-pay labor on other concern lines, the fee is repaid in the proportion the repaired line's labor charge bears to all customer-pay labor charged on the repair order, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Any other component group.** None is repaid.

The repaired concern line is the one carrying the repair order's diagnostic fee.

| Repaired component (hypothetical) | Labor share on the repaired line | Fee 5.20 repaid as |
|---|---|---|
| Air-conditioning condenser | all | 5.20 |
| Radiator (cooling) | 140.00 of 560.00 | 5.20 times 140.00 over 560.00, which is 1.30 |
| Power window motor (electrical) | all | 0.00 |
